preprocess.scale: 1.4826*MAD; if MAD <= 1e-12 use population_std; if population_std <= 1e-12 use 1; finally max(scale,1e-3)
preprocess.category_hash: SHA256(episode_encoding_seed, stable_column_identity, canonical_type_tagged_value); first 53 bits -> [-1,1); never process hash
preprocess.missing_categorical_payload: hash=0, frequency=0, unseen=0, missing=1; Fourier features all zero
preprocess.categorical_hash_collision_policy: audit actual 53-bit codes on support keys only; redraw encoding seed up to 8 attempts then hard error; query-code collisions are diagnostic only and never alter seed/codes/acceptance
preprocess.categorical_hash: SHA256(length-prefixed episode_encoding_seed, stable_column_identity, canonical_type_tagged_value); first 53 bits -> [-1,1); never process hash
preprocess.feature_evaluation_dtype: hash-to-code, normalization/ranks and Fourier phase/trigonometry float64 in reference implementation; cast finished feature vectors to float32, then BF16 matmul; validate float32 feature-evaluation fast path independently
preprocess.encoded_collision_diagnostics: report actual numeric/feature collisions after casts on fixed audit inputs; never change support encodings or task acceptance based on query collisions

cell_encoder.projection_bank: independent by offset and numeric/categorical; summed; no biases
cell_encoder.query_label_contribution: literal zeros; do not gather query label storage

front_end.row_attention: self-attention over F real feature cells plus 8 CLS, independently per row
front_end.cls_append: before first row stage, retained across second column stage without entering column attention
front_end.rope: row-attention Q/K only, feature positions 0..F-1 and CLS positions F..F+7; base10000; dimension16; reset per row
front_end.row_compression: concatenate final 8 CLS in learned-slot order, 8*128=1024

mab.qk_norm: head-wise RMS normalization with one learned head_dim gain vector for Q and one for K, shared across heads
mab.no_key_behavior: The standard sampler emits nonempty support. The generic model also defines empty support: attention with no legal keys contributes zero through the attention branch, preserving the residual path and default codec statistics. The finance sampler can exercise this boundary without fabricating labels.
mab.qk_operation_order: linear projection, reshape heads, per-head RMS and learned gain, row RoPE if active, scaled dot product

icl.attention: full multi-head, separate Q/K/V/O; no GQA
icl.support_keys: support only including own support row
icl.query_keys: support only; no query key/value enters any row
icl.padding_mask: padded support rows never keys; padded output rows excluded from loss

head.classification_loss: cross entropy over legal classes only
head.regression_loss: proper continuous NLL in standardized support-target units
head.regression_point_prediction: analytic mean including Lomax tail means; inverse support affine transformation
head.regression_boundary_convention: left tail z<-5; finite bin k=floor((z+5)/(10/128)) for -5<=z<5; right tail z>=5
head.density_original_units: p_y(y)=p_z((y-m)/s)/s; standardized training NLL omits task-constant log(s)
head.class_id_injection: sample an ordered K-element subset without replacement from 0..255 independently of outcomes; map declared task labels to those slots, mask all other slots; sample fresh injection per augmented view and align predictions by semantic class
head.deployment_class_id_mapping: map legal external labels deterministically to 0..K-1; encode label mapping as metadata; never fit mapping from query labels
head.affine_precision: Original-unit targets/center/scale remainFP64 through standardization; standardized values cast to neural probability dtype; original-unit mean/quantile inversion and serving preserveFP64.

optimizer.loss_reduction: mean valid queries within episode then sum episode losses / global episode count; never average unequal local means

muon.parameters: only registered hidden attention Q/K/V/O and SwiGLU gate/value/down matrices; each separately, no fused QKV orthogonalization
muon.ns: transpose if rows>cols; X=G/(FrobeniusNorm(G)+eps); five X=a*X+(b*A+c*A@A)@X, A=X@X.T; transpose back

adamw.parameters: all remaining parameters including encoders, label projections, head matrices, embeddings, inducing vectors, CLS, norms, frequencies and scalars

schedule.definition: linear update1..ceil(.02*T); cosine thereafter to .1 peak at T; T fixed in run manifest before training
schedule.T_source: For a final run, sum the stage update counts estimated from their GPU-hour allocations and measured update costs; freeze stage boundaries and totalT before training. One warmup/cosine schedule spans the final run. Standalone screen endpoints own separate horizons. Actual chargedGPU-hour cap overrides extrapolated step count.

optimizer.distributed: Replicated model and optimizer state on each worker, targeting 64 GPU workers when memory permits. The implemented trainer explicitly reduces FP32 gradients after all local macroepisodes in the logical batch; global activity flags distinguish globally unused parameters from locally inactive branches. Unequal local macroepisode counts use world_size/global_batch loss scaling before the averaged reduction. Full original matrices receive Muon updates after synchronization; no per-shard reinterpretation. This is manual replicated gradient reduction, not the torch DDP wrapper.
optimizer.nonfinite_gradient: skip whole optimizer update, log and checkpoint; abort after 3 consecutive skips; do not advance optimizer schedule
optimizer.globally_unused_parameter: if a parameter has no global gradient in this update, do not advance its optimizer state or apply decay; mixed-task global gradients use zeros from locally inactive branches

auxiliary.selection: independent crossed ablation after reference and base authored model are working
second_view_transforms: column permutation before grouping and RoPE
independent random injection of declared K labels into K distinct slots among all 256, aligned back by semantic class
categorical hash encoding seed redraw with support/query consistency
auxiliary.supervised_view_loss: average NLL of both views on selected episodes, one-view NLL otherwise
auxiliary.regression_consistency: symmetric stop-gradient KL over 130 bin masses plus 0.1*mean squared difference of two log tail scales; identical target transform across views

masked_conditional_retarget.target_choice: uniform among support-eligible finite numeric original X columns or categorical original X columns with independently declared complete vocabulary of size<=256; no query-based eligibility
masked_conditional_retarget.selected_target_feature: removed from support/query feature tensors before preprocessing
masked_conditional_retarget.categorical_alphabet: requires independently declared full target vocabulary before auxiliary task selection; support-only vocabulary is insufficient; no query-based skip
masked_conditional_retarget.selection_failure: skip auxiliary copy, retain main task

algorithm: reshape current row vector to eight 128-wide slots and add to saved CLS
one row MAB over cells and CLS
one support-only column ISAB over feature cells, not CLS
one row MAB over cells and CLS
r=r+tanh(g)*concat(CLS), independent scalar g initialized0 at each site
optional_feedback_branch.saved_features: retain stage-two feature cells, update between sites
optional_feedback_branch.claim: authored hypothesis for recovering feature detail, not established novelty or superior performance
optional_feedback_branch.comparison: both fixed-backbone and fixed-GPU-hour comparison; no prior changes

invariances.support_row_permutation: exact mathematical equivariance/invariance under masks, to numerical tolerance
invariances.column_permutation: not exact due grouped offsets and RoPE; augmentation/consistency only
invariances.category_recoding: not exact due numeric hash Fourier code; seed augmentation only
invariances.class_label_permutation: not exact with learned lookup/head; permutation augmentation only
invariances.numeric_affine: positive-affine invariance approximate due finite scale floor and floating point; negative affine not architectural guarantee
